vulnerability_analysis: The contract has owner-only functions that allow draining BNB: clearStuckBalance() and manualSend(). Additionally, setFeeReceivers() allows changing fee receivers. An authorized address can change marketingFeeReceiver to their address and then drain contract BNB.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, change marketingFeeReceiver to attacker address, then call manualSend() to drain contract BNB to attacker.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get contract owner address. 2. Impersonate owner with vm.prank. 3. Call setFeeReceivers() to set marketingFeeReceiver to attacker. 4. Ensure contract has BNB balance. 5. Call manualSend() to transfer all BNB to attacker. 6. Verify attacker BNB balance increased.
